en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park on a hillside with a central water fountain, trees, and a winding path leading upward. At the top left stands a large ornate building with towers and a flag. In the foreground is a street with a picket fence and a horse‑drawn carriage. To the right, an entrance gate with a wooden arch bears the inscription "G. Remele's Naturheilanstalt." A tall building stands just beyond the gate.
